semiconductor_relevance: High — CIS Corporation specializes in the sale and refurbishment of second-hand semiconductor equipment and spare parts, making it relevant to various aspects of the semiconductor industry.
summary: CIS Corporation is a direct seller and buyer of second-hand semiconductor equipment, including front-end process and test equipment, as well as major sub-systems and spare parts. They also offer refurbishment, overhaul, and upgrade services to ensure optimal performance of the equipment.
capabilities: Overhaul services for generators and pumps
